title: KurdEval — Kurdish LLM Evaluation Findings
summary: Gemini 3.x vs GPT-OSS 120B vs GPT-OSS 20B on the same 5 Kurdish prompts
key_findings: Gemini produces literary-quality Kurdish with proper grammar.
GPT-OSS models produce incoherent output with repetitive phrases.
GPT-OSS is ~5x faster but at the cost of quality.
Current LLMs still fail at Kurdish — a critical gap in low-resource language AI.
conclusion: Only Gemini 3.x produces fluent Kurdish. GPT-OSS models fail with repetition and unnatural grammar. This highlights the critical need for Kurdish-specific training data.
